newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC drafts higher wheat exports, lower stocks.
newsitem.headline: ONIC drafts higher wheat exports, lower stocks.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC plans a further increase of 150,000 tonnes in its target for 1996/97 soft wheat exports to non-EU countries to 6.4 million tonnes, a draft industry report showed on Thursday.
The unpublished draft seen by Reuters also cuts the carryover stock projection for soft wheat in the July/June campaign by 125,000 tonnes to 2.06 million tonnes.
ONIC grain forecasts are prepared in draft form each month but can be changed before publication. ONIC's next monthly report is due to be released on March 12.
ONIC last month raised its key export forecast to non-EU countries by 250,000 tonnes to 6.25 million tonnes.
In the new draft, it sees exports to other EU countries at 9.135 million tonnes, barely changed from last month.
ONIC is using a slightly lower figure for the 1996 crop of 34.578 million tonnes compared with 34.616 million in February.
Commercial flour exports outside the EU are unchanged at a grain equivalent of 2.0 million tonnes.
